search_log: Resolved the blank author field through Penguin Random House publisher pages identifying Holly Jackson as the author.
Searched "Not Quite Dead Yet" "Holly Jackson" excerpt and opened Penguin's authorized extract plus its 45-page publisher sample PDF.
Searched the title with "third person", "third person POV", "point of view", narrator, perspective, letters, and interstitials; opened explicit completed-book reviews.
Publisher catalog copy and general reviews using phrases such as "Jet's voice" or "perspective" were treated as nondiagnostic unless they explicitly identified grammatical narrative person.

Low-quality summary sites produced unsupported first-person claims, but these were contradicted directly by the authorized prose and repeated interior quotations and were not treated as credible structural evidence.
person_note: The authorized opening uses sustained third-person limited narration centered on Jet, and multiple interior Goodreads passages independently reproduce the same external narration and free-indirect style. First-person material in the quote set is overwhelmingly dialogue; q10540 is an embedded letter, consistent with a completed-book review's description of letters as interstitials, and does not create an autonomous first-person base section. Two completed-book reviews explicitly corroborate third-person narration. The only contrary web assertions came from low-quality summary pages that conflict with the primary text. The publisher extract covers only the opening, but the dispersed interior quote evidence and whole-book descriptions remove the main scope uncertainty.
